description: Governor's Office - North Western Province - Order that T. S. Vitharana, Shall be deemed to have been dismissed from the position of Mayor and a member of Kurunegala Municipal Council w.e.f. 31.12.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the dismissal of a municipal mayor (Thushara Sanjeewa Witharana) from his position due to findings of guilt in a disciplinary investigation conducted under the Municipal Council Ordinance. The content involves law enforcement procedures, disciplinary actions against a local government official, and the exercise of judicial/administrative powers by the Provincial Governor. This falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement matters as it deals with legal proceedings, enforcement of ordinances, and disciplinary actions against a public official in a law enforcement context.
